facts.finding: Semantic, formalization, world and code-retrieval bodies are converted into required text chunks; required means INVARIANT, not optional metadata.
Compiler includes every required reference or raises RequiredContextOverflowError; retry reconstruction rejects dropping or downgrading required evidence.

Semantic transport reconstructs all ordered semantic chunks and checks required flags, full-artifact binding, per-chunk hashes and bytes against the nominated current artifact. Replacing summaries with hashes would violate this contract.

The existing capsule-references@1 profile removes only its closed capsule provenance allowlist. Behavioral fields, unknown fields, raw sources, admissions, native task context and world/formalization evidence remain literal.
The profile is explicitly admitted only with full indexed arm, enabled source view, transport@1 and legacy metadata view. It is a config selection, not a user permission gap.

Descriptor@4 advertises selected-capsules@1. Existing broker retains exact selected capsules, authenticates peers and checks current source before/after page access; stale baseline expansion refuses after edits.

Capsule expansion is bounded to 16 selected capsules/32768 aggregate capsule bytes; pages carry session/source bindings, artifact and slice hashes, cursor bounds and false authority flags. This is not a general proof/world/formalization artifact endpoint.

Router compares complete rendered input bytes, including source/workspace/public/Doctor/reply/expansion wrappers; selects only a strict reduction. Selected profile performs one authenticated 4096-byte-bound preflight request before generation; preflight content is not added to model input.

DuckDB already retains vector snapshots and IntentRepository state. Native retrieval replays the query over a complete source AST and matches source/symbol/span identities before capsule ranking. Provider children are refused inherited database authority.

Owner-side worker projection already allows bounded ranked capsule subsets while retaining full source/index and exact required raw paths. Current preparation passes query and 32768-byte worker limit; required public instruction and smoke source remain literal.

Explicit one-capsule@1 and two-capsules@1 budgets and verified-retrieval-symbol-rank@1 selection exist. These change advisory selection before required chunk compilation rather than deleting required evidence afterward.

PlannerDoctor already represents satisfied proofs as optional digest handles and expansion CIDs as optional suggestions. Operational Doctor residual context currently appends an advisory to the native prompt; it does not replace the full required context.

Current source-view profiles are identity, Python whitespace and Python comments views. They do not globally rename or round-trip an entire on-disk codebase; capsule-reference profile leaves raw source inline.

Current semantic component census groups 15 other semantic fields together and non-semantic/formalization evidence together. It cannot yet identify which of those fields contributes most of the remaining bytes.

inferences.finding: Capsule provenance deferral alone has limited headroom: even the entire measured capsule value array is under 10% of the complete first input, and the existing profile removes only a subset while adding instructions/references. Its net benefit may be small or zero.

The 269557 figure covers the complete first native coding invocation, including multiple CLI turns and tool history. Shortening its initial 67380-byte input cannot by itself guarantee proportional reduction in that aggregate.

Larger safe reductions likely require a small required decision packet plus owner-retained expandable provenance/proof artifacts. Existing DuckDB/indexes can support selection and retention, but storage availability alone does not authorize replacing required bodies with digests.

larger_reduction_implementation_plan: Extend the closed census with fixed labels for reconstruction, refresh_lineage, preparation_bounds, pack, worker_projection and required_raw_paths; split world/retrieval evidence groups. Export only counts/hashes, and keep unknown field labels aggregated.

Use census evidence to choose one provenance-only field group for a new versioned disclosure policy. Keep goal, authority, acceptance, public constraints, Doctor residuals, behavioral capsule fields, required raw-source rules and unknown fields inline.

Extend the owner-admitted evidence descriptor and pager for that exact retained artifact/group, tied to task/source tree, generation, session, original artifact hash and expected expansion hash. Reuse bounded paging, authenticated peer checks, source checks, revocation and accounting. Existing selected-capsules@1 does not authorize arbitrary world/formalization retrieval.

Compile the new policy at the owner boundary before required references are produced; preserve immutable original artifact and reversible provider projection. Do not edit required=True to False or infer omission from evidence kind.

Preserve current obligations/pending proof states in the required decision packet; represent only actually satisfied proofs with existing digest-handle contracts. A Lean syntax check or autoencoder output is not a discharged behavioral obligation.

Qualify exact inverse, literal constraint preservation, unknown-field preservation, forged/missing/stale/wrong-session expansion refusal, before/after-edit behavior, end-to-end input audit, response decoding and complete-input size selection before a separate matched live ablation.

narrowest_safe_ablation.before_paid_generation: Measure complete candidate/native bytes on an owner-created authored or public-input fixture with the real router/source broker and a capturing provider. Verify selection, exact inverse, required fields, stale-source refusal and request accounting.
narrowest_safe_ablation.control: Current qualified commit, full indexed source identity@1, semantic_working_set=legacy.
narrowest_safe_ablation.measurement_gap: Existing census_only guard supports semantic metadata views and forbids working-set selection. A first-class provider-free working-set census would need a small separately qualified mode; do not silently weaken this guard.
